watches.name: The Aurora (Copy)
watches.description: Aurora Caribbean, Black Leather, White Stitching       The Aurora - The original AVeritas model. The first two layer dial concept by Mr. Grady. A stunning multi-"possibility" design. Black or white lower dial with numerous upper dial color choices. The company's "first born" is a classic. Perfect for your collection, and being a collection unto itself. Build your Aurora collection.

specsRaw.Movement: Our “Concentric” côtes de Genève movement powers the Aurora. 38 hour power reserve. Adjusted to 5 positions.

specsRaw.Dial: Custom designed and manufactured two layer dial design in multiple color combinations.

specsRaw.Functions: Hours, minutes at center. Small second hand at 6 O’clock.

watches.description: The 4-Ten - A unique two layer dial presentation of original design, colors and textures. Time keeping in colorful distinctive style, with three available color choices.

specsRaw.Case: High strength 316 stainless steel. 44mm diameter at the bezel, 42mm at the case center. 13mm height. Brushed finish.
specsRaw.Dial: Unique two layer dial design. Available in 4 color design combinations. It’s all in the details. Even the 5 tiny screws that mount the upper dial to the lower dial, are made one at a time by hand, on a manual turning center.

specsRaw.Functions: Hours, minutes, seconds at center. Date keeping by window at 3 O’clock.
